panels.description: Alex opens the sealed Measure case in the hidden workshop. B11 unfolds from inside, dust-covered and compact; leave upper space.
B11's warm amber eyes activate and the brass ring around his right eye rotates. Keep his face-like optics nonhuman and leave upper space.
Alex steps back while B11 faces him. Keep both silhouettes clear and leave upper third open for the exchange.
B11 unfolds Adrian's physical map across the workbench; its route ends beneath the sealed old works. Keep the map readable and leave upper margin.
